question_text:
Match the following :
(a)
Sivadevayya
(i)
Pratapacharitramu
(b)
Ekamranatha
(ii)
Nirostya Ramayanam
(c)
Manchana
(iii) Purushartasaram
(d)
Shakalya malla
(iv) Keyurabahu Charitra

(a)

(i)

(b) 
(ii) 
(c) 
(iii) 
(d) 
(iv) 
The correct answer is

